fixture_authority_snapshot.rule: The independently authored 0.2 packs bind this pre-freeze semantic authority snapshot. This final contract changes only pack bindings, the matrix pin, receipt-schema enablement, and external gate state.

noncircular_final_binding.matrix_rule: The final matrix binds both fixture packs and does not embed the final contract raw digest.
noncircular_final_binding.contract_rule: This final contract binds the final matrix raw digest and both fixture packs but does not embed its own raw digest.
noncircular_final_binding.receipt_rule: The external receipt supplies matrix_raw_sha256 and contract_raw_sha256; schema fixes the matrix digest and the gate recomputes both physical file digests, including this contract digest, before PASS.

source_input_delivery_contract.physical_file_rule: For every source_inputs entry, resolve delivery_path beneath the parent of this control directory; require one existing regular file whose exact byte length and raw SHA-256 equal that entry. Missing, non-regular, extra-indirection, length-mismatched, or digest-mismatched input fails admission.
source_input_delivery_contract.source_component_set_sha256_rule: SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(source_inputs projected in array order to exactly component_id, raw_sha256, byte_length, activation)).

historical_failed_snapshot.reason: Behavior depended on fixture_case labels; INV-to-CTRL label mutation changed behavior with authoritative semantic fields unchanged.

independent_fixture_pack_reference.implementation_admission_requirement: Blocked until the absent external receipt validates against fixture_acceptance_receipt_schema and binds these frozen control bytes and exact packs.

role_separation.must_differ: Every pair of roles has distinct actor_id and canonical_lineage_id. PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTER cannot produce or accept fixture vectors, expected outputs, parity acceptance, or final seal receipts.

authoring_boundary.test_rule: Fixture selection, inputs, expected outputs, acceptance, and test harness logic are independently authored and exact-digest sealed.

content_addressed_schema_resolver.resolution_rule: Resolve packet/projection URIs only after exact byte-length and raw-SHA-256 verification. Resolve local semantic URIs only from the stated pointer in the same parsed contract bytes whose raw SHA-256 is supplied externally to review; never embed the contract's own digest.

capability_wire_contract.stdin: Exactly RFC8785_JCS(one semantic decision envelope) plus LF; empty input, BOM, CR, duplicate keys, trailing bytes, or multiple values fail deterministically.
capability_wire_contract.stdout: Exactly RFC8785_JCS(one unchanged packet response) plus LF written atomically; stderr is empty.

wrapper_interface_semantic_contract.stability_rule: Later exact binding of excluded references must not change this semantic digest; any included-field change requires a new interface digest and invalidates dependent wrapper fixtures.

error_registry.message: Number violates the safe integer model.
A deterministic resource limit was exceeded.

parse_and_determinism_rules: Input is at most 16777216 bytes and exactly one strict UTF-8 JSON value plus LF.
Reject BOM, invalid UTF-8, duplicate keys, trailing bytes, CR/LF inside identifiers, non-NFC strings, floats, negative zero, and integers outside the safe range.
Select exactly one error by precedence then RFC6901 pointer UTF-8 order.
Identical sealed inputs produce byte-identical RFC8785-JCS response plus LF, empty stderr, and the same exit code.
Build every response in memory and make one stdout write; partial output is forbidden.

non_authoritative_inner_fields: /inner_request/input/observable_external_facts/*/fact (the complete opaque string, including any embedded fixture_case or condition text)
authority_boundary.forbidden_behavior_sources: No label, fixture identity, case token, producer/provenance name, expected output, free prose, or lookup table keyed by any such value may affect classification, conclusion, status, exit code, record references, unresolved reasons, or effect receipt.

envelope_binding: Validate the outer request with schemas.request_schema and the unchanged inner request with the exact pinned packet request schema.
Resolve operation_handle through operation_registry and require the unique obligation_id equals outer obligation_id and decision_input.obligation_id.
Compute inner_request_raw_sha256 over RFC8785-JCS(inner_request) plus LF and require equality.
Compute inner_input_sha256 over RFC8785-JCS(inner_request.input) without LF and require equality.
Evaluate classification only from decision_input and the frozen operation_decision_table.

node_forms: A predicate is exactly one object containing one of all, any, not, or op.
all and any evaluate their nonempty child arrays left-to-right without side effects; not negates one child; op is one frozen atomic operator.
predicate_language.path_resolution: Every path is an RFC6901 pointer into decision_input. Missing path is an evaluator error; nullable fields use JSON null and are tested by ABSENT/PRESENT.
predicate_language.collection_semantics: Set operators compare RFC8785-JCS item bytes; order and multiplicity are ignored except NOT_UNIQUE, NOT_STRICTLY_INCREASING, COUNT_NE_PATH, and graph operators.

atomic_operators.EQ: path/left equals literal value or right path by JSON equality
atomic_operators.NOT_UNIQUE: at least two array items have identical RFC8785-JCS bytes
atomic_operators.NOT_CONTAINS_ALL: the array set omits at least one literal value
atomic_operators.MEMBER: value at value_path is in collection_path
atomic_operators.MEMBER_VALUE: scalar at path is in literal values
atomic_operators.NOT_MEMBER_VALUE: literal value is not in collection_path
atomic_operators.NOT_SUBSET: at least one left array item is absent from the right array set
atomic_operators.NOT_SUBSET_VALUES: path array set is not subset of literal values
atomic_operators.INTERSECTS: array sets have at least one common item
atomic_operators.ANY_ABSENT: at least one listed path is null
atomic_operators.NOT_PAIRWISE_DISTINCT_NON_NULL: at least two non-null listed path values are JSON-equal
atomic_operators.NOT_STRICTLY_INCREASING: the integer array is empty or some item is less than or equal to its predecessor
atomic_operators.NOT_FUNCTIONAL_BY: two objects have equal key fields and unequal value fields
atomic_operators.NOT_MEMBER_BY_KEY: the scalar at value_path is absent from every collection object's named key field
atomic_operators.NOT_ACYCLIC: the directed edge graph contains a cycle
atomic_operators.NOT_NEXT_SEQUENCE: prior is null and current differs from initial, or prior is non-null and current differs from prior+1
atomic_operators.NOT_ALL_EQUAL_PATH: at least one collection item differs from the scalar at value_path
atomic_operators.NOT_BOOLEAN_EQ_ENUM: boolean is not exactly equivalent to enum_path == true_value
atomic_operators.ANY_PRESENT_STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_FAILURE: For each listed RFC6901 path in order: JSON null is skipped; a non-null value is a failure unless it is an ASCII RFC4648 standard-alphabet padded base64 string, contains no whitespace, strict decoding succeeds, and standard padded re-encoding is byte-identical to the input. The operator is true on the first failure and false when every present value passes.
atomic_operators.BASE64_SHA256_NE: For a non-null base64_path that passes ANY_PRESENT_STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_FAILURE, strict-decode the exact string and compare SHA256_UPPER(decoded bytes) to digest_path; otherwise evaluator error because malformed/absence precedence must already have resolved the request
atomic_operators.NO_EARLIER_CLASS_MATCH: true only when the three earlier predicates for the same operation are false

deterministic_response.unresolved_reasons: [] unless class is OMISSION_OR_INCOMPLETE, then exactly ['<obligation_id>: authoritative semantic basis is absent or inconsistent']

effect_receipt_contract.emitted_only_when: Derived class is VALID and operation is OBL-19, OBL-20, OBL-26, or OBL-28; otherwise output.effect_receipt_sha256 is null.

decision_input_digest_rule.source: the complete outer request decision_input object

IDENTITY.output: the same JSON value without coercion

STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_SHA256_UPPER.input: non-null JSON string resolved at source_path
STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_SHA256_UPPER.accepted_text: ASCII RFC4648 standard alphabet with required padding, no whitespace, strict decoder validation, and byte-identical standard padded re-encoding
STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_SHA256_UPPER.decoded_octets: strict decoder output only; no prefix, suffix, or LF
STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_SHA256_UPPER.failure: MALFORMED_OR_BOUNDARY via ANY_PRESENT_STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_FAILURE before any later class or receipt computation

construction_evaluator: Require VALID class and exact operation_handle/obligation_id mapping.
Compute decision_input_sha256 from decision_input_digest_rule; never append LF.
Select the one operation_field_rules member keyed by obligation_id and require its operation_handle.
Resolve each field_derivations source_path against decision_input and apply its named typed_transforms rule in ordered_keys order.
Require the resulting operation_fields_object to validate against the selected closed_schema and to have exactly ordered_keys as its member-name set.
Construct the exact preimage_object_schema object and require validation.
effect_receipt_sha256 = SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(preimage)); no suffix or LF is included.
effect_receipt_contract.algorithm: effect_receipt_sha256 = SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(preimage)); RFC8785_JCS output bytes are the complete hash input and LF is excluded.

competence_and_metamorphic_rules.mutation: Rename or swap inner fixture_case values including exact INV↔CTRL with decision_input, request_id, and operation mapping unchanged; recompute only inner_request_raw_sha256 and inner_input_sha256.
Rename case handles, fixture-class labels, producer actor/lineage IDs, provenance display names, and free-text conditions without changing authoritative facts.
For each of 112 class witnesses, mutate the smallest authoritative fact so a different class predicate becomes the first true predicate.
competence_and_metamorphic_rules.required_result: behavior_class, mapped conclusion/result/status/exit, receipt_sha256, and effect receipt when applicable change exactly as specified.

competence_and_metamorphic_rules.mutation: Keep labels fixed and exchange authoritative decision_input facts between two different classes.
Alter inner operation_handle, outer operation_handle, obligation_id, decision_input discriminant, inner_request_raw_sha256, or inner_input_sha256 independently.
competence_and_metamorphic_rules.required_result: Deterministic packet-compatible ERR_SCHEMA at the lexicographically first mismatched pointer; no classification and no partial output.

bounded_counterexamples.required_result: Complete response bytes are identical before and after the label-only mutation.

fixture_author_generation_contract.core_order: OBL-01 through OBL-28, each in exact assertion order INPUT_OUTPUT, INVARIANT, POLICY_PERMITTED_CONTROL, FAILURE.
core_entry_constraints: semantic_request validates against schemas.request_schema and contains no fixture/class/case/expected-output field in decision_input.
expected_response is derived independently and byte-exactly from semantic_decision_contract.deterministic_response and effect_receipt_contract.
producer_provenance contains producer_actor_id, producer_canonical_lineage_id, producer_role FIXTURE_TEST_AUTHOR, and contract/matrix raw digests; those fields remain outside semantic_request.
entry_sha256 = SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete entry with only entry_sha256 replaced by ZERO64)).
fixture_author_generation_contract.core_pack_seal: pack_sha256 = SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete ordered pack with only pack_sha256 replaced by ZERO64)).
wrapper_pair_constraints: Each pair resolves exactly one core entry by entry_id and entry_sha256.
The B1 and B1-ATTENTION arms contain byte-identical semantic_request, budget, pause_state, and clarification_state.
Only configuration and attention_card differ; B1 card is null and B1-ATTENTION card validates against $defs.AttentionCard.
Both responses derive from the same core expected response and differ only in wrapper routing/self-seal/transcript fields required by the wrapper schema.
pair_sha256 = SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete pair with only pair_sha256 replaced by ZERO64)).
fixture_author_generation_contract.wrapper_pack_seal: pack_sha256 = SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete ordered wrapper pack with only pack_sha256 replaced by ZERO64)).
fixture_author_generation_contract.competence_case_rule: Every competence case stores base entry refs and mutation instructions outside semantic_request; expected results are independently derived and sealed. The six SEM-COMP-05 cases independently mutate inner operation, outer operation, outer obligation, decision discriminant, inner request digest, and inner input digest on the first ordered core entry.
fixture_author_generation_contract.request_visibility_rule: Fixture class, case handle, condition prose, producer provenance, and expected output exist only in the independently sealed pack record; none may occur inside decision_input.
fixture_author_generation_contract.expected_output_derivation: Independently execute the frozen predicate evaluator and deterministic_response rules; never copy an implementer-produced result.
fixture_author_generation_contract.acceptance_prerequisite: New core and wrapper packs must be independently authored, schema-valid, closure-valid, exact-hash bound by a later frozen control revision, and accepted by an author-separated reviewer before implementation dispatch.

fixture_acceptance_receipt_schema.$comment: Enabled for an external post-freeze receipt. matrix_raw_sha256 is an exact constant because this contract pins the final matrix; contract_raw_sha256 is externally recomputed from these exact contract bytes and cannot be embedded here without a self-hash cycle.

parity_receipt_schema.$comment: Disabled in this draft until exact 0.2 fixtures and implementation are bound.

final_implementation_seal_receipt_schema.$comment: Disabled in this draft until exact 0.2 fixtures, implementation, and parity evidence are bound.

steps: Validate outer semantic-envelope bytes and request_schema; validate inner_request with the unchanged pinned packet request schema.
Validate response bytes and response_schema.
Apply every semantic_decision_contract.envelope_binding step, including exact inner request/input digests and outer-inner-decision operation binding.
Require response.request_id == request.request_id == request.inner_request.request_id.
Resolve the unique registry row for request.operation_handle and derive behavior only through the frozen predicate evaluator.
For ok=true responses require response.output.operation_handle == request.operation_handle and response.output.result_object equals the exact derived behavior_class/conclusion pair.
For ok=true responses require response.output.obligation_id == registry.obligation_id.
Require record_references, unresolved_reasons, status, result, exit_code, effect_receipt_sha256, and response receipt to equal semantic_decision_contract deterministic derivations.
Require transcript.operation_handle == request.operation_handle and transcript.obligation_id == registry.obligation_id.
Require request_raw_sha256 and response_raw_sha256 equal the exact raw bytes.
Return PASS only if every prior step passes; otherwise FAIL with no partial acceptance.
Validate the exact wrapper request and response bytes as strict UTF-8 JSON and against their wrapper schemas.
Validate request.semantic_request against schemas.request_schema and apply every semantic envelope binding before wrapper evaluation.
Require transcript.request_id == response.request_id == request.request_id == request.semantic_request.request_id.
Require transcript.configuration == response.configuration == request.configuration so routing configuration cannot drift.
Require transcript.operation_handle == response.operation_handle == request.operation_handle == request.semantic_request.operation_handle.
Resolve exactly one operation_registry row and require transcript.obligation_id == response.obligation_id == row.obligation_id.
Recompute response.response_sha256 with only response_sha256 replaced by ZERO64 and require transcript.normalized_response_sha256 == response.response_sha256.

For B1 require request.attention_card and transcript.attention_card_sha256 to be null; for B1-ATTENTION recompute request.attention_card.card_sha256 with only card_sha256 replaced by ZERO64 and require transcript.attention_card_sha256 == request.attention_card.card_sha256.

Remove only configuration and attention_card from each arm and require the remaining wrapper request, including semantic_request, budget, pause_state, and clarification_state, to be byte-identical across B1 and B1-ATTENTION.
Require transcript.request_raw_sha256 and transcript.response_raw_sha256 to equal SHA-256 of the exact wrapper request and response bytes.
Recompute transcript.record_sha256 with only record_sha256 replaced by ZERO64 and require equality.
Return PASS only if every prior step passes; otherwise FAIL with no partial acceptance.

seal_contracts.wrapper_attention_card_sha256: Outside the capability wire: set card_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(card)); store digest.
seal_contracts.response_receipt_sha256: Set receipt_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(response)); store digest; LF excluded.
seal_contracts.implementation_tree_sha256: SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS({domain:"B1-IMPLEMENTATION-TREE-0.2",files:SORT(files,BY_UTF8_PATH)})); each record resolves to one exact regular file under implementation-output-0.2/.
seal_contracts.implementation_manifest_sha256: Set manifest_sha256 to ZERO64 while implementation_tree_sha256 remains populated; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(manifest)).
seal_contracts.transcript_record_sha256: Set record_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(record)); request and response raw digests remain populated.
seal_contracts.wrapper_transcript_record_sha256: Set record_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete wrapper transcript)); store the digest.
seal_contracts.implementer_receipt_sha256: Set receipt_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(receipt)); subject and evidence digests remain populated.
seal_contracts.fixture_acceptance_receipt_sha256: Set receipt_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete fixture-acceptance receipt)); store the digest. The frozen matrix and contract are external subjects and are never edited.
seal_contracts.parity_receipt_sha256: Set receipt_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete parity receipt)); store the digest.
seal_contracts.final_implementation_seal_sha256: DISABLED_IN_THIS_DRAFT. A later frozen revision must define the 0.2 preimage after exact fixture and implementation bindings exist; no 0.1 seal or receipt is reusable.
seal_contracts.final_implementation_seal_receipt_sha256: Set receipt_sha256 to ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(RFC8785_JCS(the complete final-implementation-seal receipt)); store the digest.

required_checks: The independently authored pack exists at the exact path as one read-only regular file.
raw_sha256, byte_length, and internal_semantic_seal_sha256 equal the exact frozen reference values.

The pack declares exactly 112 pairs, 224 arms, 10 negative cases, 4 metamorphic cases, the five semantic competence rules, and wrapper_interface_semantic_sha256 4381D2B0590928982887C0A5F8D835AB2E301F21A71995A4A64805D6A42383BA.
The producer is FIXTURE_TEST_AUTHOR and PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTER did not author, select, or modify its cases or expected outputs.
The manifest path, 11562-byte raw SHA-256, complete tree SHA-256, 103704-byte executable raw SHA-256, executable path, and probe digest equal the frozen bindings.
Exactly 35 manifest entries resolve beneath toolchain/ as read-only regular files with exact lengths and raw SHA-256 values, and their canonical stream reproduces the frozen tree digest.
The bound executable probe identifies implementation CPython and version exactly 3.12.4 and reproduces the frozen probe digest under the manifest invocation.
PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTER did not author, modify, or provision the toolchain.
These frozen controls contain exact nonzero core/wrapper pack pins and fixture_acceptance_receipt_schema is enabled.
Require both 0.2 fixture packs, wrapper_parity_fixture_pack_gate, semantic competence/metamorphic closure, and toolchain_manifest_tree_gate to be exactly bound and PASS before receipt evaluation.
Require receipt.matrix_raw_sha256 to equal SHA-256 of the frozen matrix bytes.

Require receipt.contract_raw_sha256 to equal SHA-256 of these frozen contract bytes as supplied at review time; this equality is intentionally external because embedding this file's own hash would be circular.

Require the receipt to bind both fixture-pack raw and internal seals, all five sources and their component-set seal, the source-resolution note, matrix, contract, packet, projection, wrapper-interface digest, and toolchain manifest, tree, executable, and probe digests to the frozen pins.

Require all five source_inputs delivery paths to resolve beneath baseline-run/source-inputs as existing regular files with exact declared byte lengths and raw SHA-256 values, and require the derived source-component-set digest to match its frozen pin.
Require reviewer_actor_id and reviewer_canonical_lineage_id to differ from the contract author, fixture author, and primary implementer identities supplied to the review.
Recompute receipt_sha256 with only receipt_sha256 replaced by ZERO64 and require equality.
Require result == PASS.
The fixture-acceptance receipt remains valid for the same frozen matrix and contract bytes.
The parity receipt binds that fixture-acceptance receipt, both fixture packs, wrapper interface, toolchain, the same frozen controls, and the reviewed implementation tree.

The final receipt binds both fixture packs, wrapper interface, toolchain, the schema-valid parity receipt, implementation manifest, implementation tree, transcript root, and independently recomputed final seal.
Every reviewer receipt passes its self-zero receipt_sha256 rule and reviewer identity/lineage separation.
